metaData.title: Kuaishou Open-Sources Keye 2.0: Introducing DSA Attention to Multimodal AI, Pioneering a New Paradigm for Enhanced Reasoning
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: Kuaishou open-sources the Keye-VL-2.0-30B-A3B multimodal large model, pioneering the integration of DeepSeek's DSA sparse attention into multimodal scenarios. With 30B total parameters and 3B activated parameters, it achieves SOTA in video understanding, surpassing multiple 200B+ open-source models on various benchmarks.
metaData.summary: This article introduces the newly open-sourced multimodal large model, Keye-VL-2.0-30B-A3B, from Kuaishou. The core innovation of this model lies in being the first to introduce DeepSeek's DSA (DeepSeek Sparse Attention) mechanism into multimodal scenarios, achieving a 256K ultra-long context capability and reducing long-sequence Prefill costs by 50%. The model adopts an MoE architecture with 30B total parameters and only 3B activated parameters during inference. It achieves 30B-level SOTA on multiple video understanding benchmarks, including VideoMME V2, LongVideoBench, and MLVU, and surpasses several 200B+ open-source models. The article details the model's capabilities in long video understanding (e.g., process decomposition, documentary narrative deconstruction), highlight moment extraction, and Agent task scheduling. It also introduces the MOPD technique for overcoming catastrophic forgetting and the Context-RL mechanism for improving reasoning reliability. Finally, it provides examples of model deployment and invocation based on SGLang.

mainPoints.point: Keye-VL-2.0 is the first to introduce DSA sparse attention into multimodal scenarios, enabling efficient long video understanding.
mainPoints.explanation: By combining sparse attention with feature aggregation via DSA, the model effectively purifies information when processing hour-long videos, reducing long-sequence Prefill costs by 50%, thus providing a low-cost solution for ultra-long video applications.

mainPoints.point: With an MoE architecture of 30B total and 3B activated parameters, it achieves SOTA on multiple video understanding benchmarks.
mainPoints.explanation: On benchmarks like VideoMME V2, LongVideoBench, and MLVU, Keye-VL-2.0 not only leads among models of its size but also surpasses larger models like Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B, validating the efficiency of its architecture.

mainPoints.point: The model features a built-in Agent collaboration mechanism, excelling in code and tool invocation tasks.
mainPoints.explanation: The Keye series is the first to natively embed Agent capabilities in a multimodal base model, achieving leading results on benchmarks like LivecodeBench, SWE-bench, and TAU2-Bench, and can autonomously plan and execute complex multi-step API calls.

mainPoints.point: Introduces MOPD and Context-RL techniques to overcome catastrophic forgetting and enhance reasoning reliability.
mainPoints.explanation: MOPD addresses the forgetting problem in multi-task learning through multi-expert strategy distillation and merging; Context-RL uses mixed-modal reference information to construct dense reward signals, suppressing hallucinations and ensuring the model strictly anchors its reasoning to the input information.

keyQuotes: Keye-VL-2.0-30B-A3B is the first to apply DSA in multimodal scenarios, combining sparse attention with feature aggregation to effectively purify information when processing hour-long video sequences, accurately capturing key frames and clarifying dynamic patterns.
With the introduction of DSA, long-sequence Prefill costs are reduced by 50%.
VideoMME V2: The industry generally faces the problem that 'the more input frames, the more diluted the attention and the lower the accuracy.' Keye-VL-2.0-30B-A3B reverses this trend.

The Keye series is the first to natively embed an Agent collaboration mechanism in a multimodal base model, building stable and reliable automated scheduling capabilities for complex multi-step tasks.

relatedArticles.title: Xiaohongshu Open-Sources FireRed-OCR: 2B Parameter Model Tops Document Parsing Leaderboard
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Xiaohongshu has open-sourced the 2B-parameter FireRed-OCR model, which achieves performance surpassing ultra-large-scale general models in document parsing through innovative three-stage training and format-constrained reinforcement learning.

relatedArticles.title: Alibaba Tongyi Lab Open-Sources Mobile-Agent-v3.5: A Truly "Multi-Platform Ready" Native GUI Agent Foundation Model
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Alibaba Tongyi Lab has open-sourced the Mobile-Agent-v3.5 and GUI-Owl-1.5 model families, building a unified native GUI Agent foundation across multiple platforms through hybrid data flywheels and multi-platform reinforcement learning.

relatedArticles.title: From 3% to 80% Adoption Rate: The Evolution of Intelligent Unit Test Generation
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article details the practical experience of Kuaishou's R&D efficiency team in increasing the adoption rate of AI-powered unit test generation from 3% to 80% through architectural evolution (from pure LLM heuristics to a dual-driven approach of knowledge and rules).

relatedArticles.title: MemPrivacy Open-Source: Let Cloud-Edge Agents Remember You Without Handing Over Your Privacy
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: The MemPrivacy open-source project proposes a local reversible pseudonymization scheme that allows cloud-edge agents to protect privacy while almost entirely preserving reasoning and memory capabilities.

relatedArticles.title: Tair and SGLang Jointly Build a Hierarchical Cache Architecture for DeepSeek V4
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article details the hierarchical cache architecture built by the Alibaba Cloud Tair KVCache team and the SGLang community for DeepSeek V4. Through three core components—Shadow Radix, HiCache, and HiSparse—it addresses the logical description of KV Cache in long-context inference, prefix reuse during the Prefill phase, and GPU memory bottlenecks during the Decode phase, respectively.

relatedArticles.title: Hunyuan Embodied-0.5 Open Source: Designed for Real-World Embodied Agents, a New Foundation for Physical Agents
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Tencent's Hunyuan team has open-sourced the HY-Embodied-0.5 model series, which significantly enhances edge-side model capabilities in 3D spatial perception and physical planning through a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture and large-scale embodied data.

relatedArticles.title: MiniMax M3: Cutting-edge Coding, 1M Context, Native Multimodal — All in One Model
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: MiniMax releases the M3 model, integrating cutting-edge coding capabilities, 1M ultra-long context, and native multimodality, making it the first domestic model to combine these features, and it has been open-sourced.

relatedArticles.title: Meituan LongCat-Next: Turning Images, Audio, and Text into Tokens—What's Next?
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Meituan has released LongCat-Next, a multimodal large model that unifies images, audio, and text into discrete tokens via the Discrete Native Autoregressive (DiNA) framework, achieving deep integration of understanding and generation capabilities.

relatedArticles.title: Face Intelligence Open-Sources Two Edge-Side Models: MiniCPM5-1B Beats 2B with 1B Parameters, BitCPM-CANN Unlocks 6x VRAM Efficiency
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Face Intelligence, in collaboration with Tsinghua University, open-sources MiniCPM5-1B and BitCPM-CANN. The former surpasses 2B-level models with just 1B parameters, while the latter achieves 6x VRAM efficiency through 1.58-bit quantization, marking a breakthrough in domestic computing power based on the full Huawei Ascend stack.

relatedArticles.title: AI x Frontend Performance & Stability: Intelligent Diagnosis Practices at Kuaishou's Billion-Scale DAU
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Kuaishou built the "Conan AI" platform, utilizing an Agent architecture to model expert troubleshooting experience, achieving intelligent diagnosis and automated emergency response for frontend performance issues at a billion-scale DAU.
